description: This class, PageStatistics, extends the Statistics class and provides methods to analyze a collection of Book objects to find the book with the most pages and calculate the average number of pages. It operates on books within a specific shelf and filters books with specified page counts.

classes.name: PageStatistics
classes.description: Provides statistical analysis for books based on page counts within a shelf.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the book with the highest number of pages.

methods.name: findBooksWithPageCountSpecified
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of books that have a specified page count.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLength
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average number of pages among books with specified page counts.
